new_claims.statement: An exact rank-r>=2 cross block between disjoint original-coordinate banks gives a uniform inverse-half potential bound [4r/(r-1)] Delta_r^(-1/(2r)); if one bank is exactly r literal coordinates, improve by 2^(-1/4).

If a literal scalar pivot a is nonzero and its Schur complement has a rank-two cross block from a literal two-coordinate bank to a disjoint original-coordinate bank with singular-value product Delta_2, then ||p_Q||inf <= 2^(11/4)|a|^(-1/2)Delta_2^(-1/4), with the same coefficient for interval length.

actual_mathematical_premises.scope: Grouped exact-rank crossing characteristic-function estimate with arbitrary same-bank phases and projected-density caps.
